answer: Give agents credit only against collateral registered under a single enforceable lien, never a fresh-account allowance. Let that lien anchor every loan: even a juniper trading bot creating 1,000 aliases cannot pledge the same asset twice. At the nadir of a default, lenders seize the collateral. A farm must supply another dollar of unencumbered assets for each added dollar of borrowing, so clones cannot multiply unsecured buying power.
